build_object_detection_input: build an ObjectDetectionInput with a base64-encoded image string and optional threshold parameter
create_object_detection_parameters: create ObjectDetectionParameters with a confidence threshold for filtering predictions
parse_object_detection_output: parse server response JSON into ObjectDetectionOutputElement instances with bounding boxes and labels
test_object_detection_bounding_box: test ObjectDetectionBoundingBox with xmin, ymin, xmax, ymax coordinates relative to image top-left
summarize_object_detection_output_elemen: summarize ObjectDetectionOutputElement containing a box, label string, and confidence score
